description: User update rules: field validation, role change and last-administrator protection.

cases.inputs: id: that account; FullName: "Lê Văn Anh"; Email: "a@x.vn" (unchanged); RoleId: "Thành viên" (unchanged).
cases.log: Audit row UserUpdated (details { before, after }); log "Account {UserId} updated by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account "Lê Văn A" <a@x.vn> with role "Thành viên".
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10) with FullName "Lê Văn Anh"; no session is ended and nobody is notified.

cases.inputs: id: <random Guid with no account>; valid request.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(NotFound) (HTTP 404, no message code); nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[fullName] = "Họ tên không được để trống."; the account is unchanged.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[fullName] = "Họ tên không được vượt quá 200 ký tự.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10).

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[email] = "Email không hợp lệ.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[email] = "Email không hợp lệ.".

cases.inputs: RoleId: unknown Guid; other fields valid.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account exists.
No role has the submitted id.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[roleId] = "Vai trò không tồn tại."; the previous role is kept.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Another account already uses b@x.vn.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(DuplicateEmail) (MSG08); the account is unchanged.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account a@x.vn exists.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10): keeping your own email is not a duplicate.

cases.log: Log "Update rejected: email already taken (unique index)."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Email is free when checked, but a concurrent request takes it before this save.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(DuplicateEmail) (MSG08); the unsaved changes are discarded and no audit row is written.

cases.log: Warning log "Update rejected: changing the role of {UserId} would leave no active administrator."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Account is the only active holder of AdminUsers (role "Quản trị viên").
Target role "Thành viên" does not hold AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12); the account keeps its role.

cases.inputs: id: the first administrator; RoleId: "Thành viên".
cases.log: Audit row UserUpdated; calendar shares of the person stop if the new role lacks MeetingCreator; capabilities-changed notice sent.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Two active accounts hold AdminUsers; the target is one of them.
Target role "Thành viên" does not hold AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10); the role changes and the account is told (capability change published); the session stays.

cases.log: Audit row UserUpdated; capabilities-changed notice sent.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The target is the only active administrator.
Target role "Trợ lý" also holds AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10): the new role keeps AdminUsers, so nobody loses the capability.

cases.inputs: FullName changed; Email and RoleId unchanged.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The target is the only active administrator.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10): the last-administrator rule is checked only when the role moves.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The target account is deactivated and is the former sole holder of AdminUsers.
No active administrator remains.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10): an inactive account administers nothing, so changing its role cannot remove the last administrator; nobody is notified.

cases.log: Audit row UserUpdated; sessions of the account ended.
cases.note:
UC-06b · BR-17 · MSG10
Deviation: BR-17 and UC-06b limit this update to Full Name, but the code also changes Email (ending the session) and System Role (UC-08).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active non-administrator account.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10); every refresh token and any open password-reset link of the account are revoked after the commit; no role-change notice is sent.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account; role and email both change.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10); sessions are ended because of the email change and no capability notice is sent (the session does not survive).

cases.inputs: Email: "A@x.vn" (only the letter case differs from the stored a@x.vn).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10); the email counts as changed (ordinal compare), so sessions are ended.

cases.log: Error log "Account {UserId} was changed, but ending its sessions failed."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Ending the sessions fails (Redis unavailable) after the commit.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10): the failure is logged, not raised; the session lapses with the access token.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account whose new role lacks MeetingCreator and who views calendar shares.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG10); the Effective shares the person views are stopped (reason ViewerLostMeetingCreator).

precondition: Admin actor with user-management capability; target user and roles seeded.
